name: Moorfields hand-woven wool runner, beige, 80x200 (Rowico Home, via IDANA)
texture: hand-woven, low pile 0.8 cm; weave and pattern not described

warm-modern.reason: Estimate: 100% wool in beige, low and tonal if the weave is plain, but 80 wide and 200 long means 3-4 pieces for a 680-700 corridor, and the pattern is unverified.

notes: Corridor runner-rug line (7.3 row 25: 60-70 x 680-700, flat wool or wool-jute, L* 65-78, no pattern). Read from the official product page, no contact. MISSES: width 80 (spec 60-70) and length 200 only; the spec allows two parts with a gap up to 3 cm, here it would need 3-4 pieces end to end, which breaks the line. Single size 80x200. Colours offered: saffron yellow, olive green, wool beige; only the beige fits. Pattern and weave are not described, so 'no pattern' is UNVERIFIED. The rug is hand-made (handmade tag, allowed if serial). Beige L* is estimated from the colour name, not sampled (UNVERIFIED). The same brand's 290x200 Moorfields (1,950 ILS, RO-123265) is a living-room size and not carded. In stock (page), 12-month warranty. Photos: 7 on the page, real or render UNVERIFIED. SHIPPING TO ISRAEL, two options: cheapest = pickup from the warehouse by prior arrangement (as on other IDANA pages, not stated on this one); fastest reasonable = supplier delivery 120 ILS, area Hadera to Ashkelon to Modi'in.
